correctness.rationale: The orthogonal postprojection decomposition and exact lagged one-dimensional recursion are verified. Stationary cached-noise autocovariance and the absolutely convergent geometric double sum give the exact risk for every allowed real parameter, including rate endpoints. Strict convexity and the feasibility interval yield the unique clipped optimizer. The standalone exact rational transition calculation passed 8100 assertions.

value.rationale: The formula resolves the practical choice of how to allocate a fixed per-sweep fresh-measurement budget between nearly parallel equations, proving the qualitative difference between one-sided diverging risk and balanced bounded risk. It is an exact stationary risk design law with a natural acquisition-cost constraint, not merely a marginally improved constant or restatement of a generic covariance identity.
